def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Get grasp candidates for the object
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    best_candidate = None
    best_score = -1
    for c in candidates:
        if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - c["object_long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
            if c["score"] > best_score:
                best_score = c["score"]
                best_candidate = c
    if best_candidate is None:
        best_candidate = candidates[0]

    # Grasp the object
    grasp(best_candidate)
    if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to grasp {obj_name}")

    # Find free spots in the target zone
    spots = free_spots(zone_name, obj_name)
    if not spots["spots"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No free spot in {zone_name}")

    spot = spots["spots"][0]
    target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]  # Align object long axis with zone
    object_long_axis_at_grasp = best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
    delta_yaw = target_yaw - object_long_axis_at_grasp
    rotate_by(delta_yaw)

    # Move to the spot and place the object
    carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=None)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)
